note: Smallest run file. Needs nothing installed. Run it from the repo root and pass no --cwd: the harness is spawned in the workspace root, so a relative "node mock-agent.mjs" resolves only when that root is this repo. node run.ts --file assets/example/single_mock.json

tasks.note: One asking task plus a TTY is the only shape where ask survives a run file; two askers cannot share one prompt and re-resolve as safe.
